scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @bazm/domain && npm run build --workspace frontend && npm run build --workspace functions
scripts.build:emulators: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=https://bazm.online NEXT_PUBLIC_USE_FIREBASE_EMULATORS=true NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_API_KEY=demo-api-key NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN=demo-bazm-online.firebaseapp.com NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=demo-bazm-online NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET=demo-bazm-online.appspot.com NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID=123 NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_APP_ID=1:123:web:emulators NEXT_PUBLIC_ENABLE_GOOGLE_AUTH=false npm run build
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @bazm/domain && npm run lint --workspace frontend && npm run lint --workspace functions && npm run lint --workspace @bazm/rules-tests
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @bazm/domain && npm run typecheck --workspace @bazm/domain && npm run typecheck --workspace frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace functions && npm run typecheck --workspace @bazm/rules-tests
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @bazm/domain && npm run test --workspace @bazm/domain && npm run test --workspace frontend && npm run test --workspace functions
scripts.check: npm run test:phase20:static && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run config:audit
scripts.test:emulators: npm run build:emulators && npm run prepare:emulators && node tests/phase-3-indexes.mjs && DEBUG= METADATA_SERVER_DETECTION=none CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=true CHOKIDAR_INTERVAL=500 NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3119 NEXT_PUBLIC_USE_FIREBASE_EMULATORS=true NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_API_KEY=demo-api-key NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN=demo-bazm-online.firebaseapp.com NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=demo-bazm-online NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET=demo-bazm-online.appspot.com NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID=123 NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_APP_ID=1:123:web:phase19 NEXT_PUBLIC_ENABLE_GOOGLE_AUTH=false npx --yes firebase-tools@latest emulators:exec --project demo-bazm-online --only auth,firestore,functions,storage "npm run test --workspace @bazm/rules-tests && node tests/functions-health.mjs && node tests/registration-flow.mjs && node tests/phase-2-auth-flow.mjs && node tests/phase-3-persistence-flow.mjs && node tests/phase-4-category-flow.mjs && node tests/phase-5-product-flow.mjs && node tests/phase-6-storefront-flow.mjs && node tests/phase-7-cart-flow.mjs && node tests/phase-8-inventory-flow.mjs && node tests/phase-9-checkout-flow.mjs && node tests/phase-10-payment-flow.mjs && node tests/phase-11-email-flow.mjs && node tests/phase-12-admin-flow.mjs && node tests/phase-13-crm-flow.mjs && node tests/phase-14-review-flow.mjs && node tests/phase-15-return-flow.mjs && node tests/phase-16-seo-flow.mjs && node tests/phase-17-performance-flow.mjs && node tests/phase-18-security-flow.mjs && npm run test:phase19 && npm run test:phase20"
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run test:emulators
scripts.emulators: npm run prepare:emulators && DEBUG= METADATA_SERVER_DETECTION=none CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=true CHOKIDAR_INTERVAL=500 npx --yes firebase-tools@latest emulators:start --project demo-bazm-online
scripts.emulators:exec: npm run prepare:emulators && DEBUG= METADATA_SERVER_DETECTION=none CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=true CHOKIDAR_INTERVAL=500 npx --yes firebase-tools@latest emulators:exec --project demo-bazm-online --only auth,firestore,functions,storage "npm run test"
